subject: HelixOps reference deployment validation & test plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amina Farouk <amina@helixops.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@helixops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelixOps reference deployment validation & test plan

Hi Amina, Devon —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We think HelixOps is a great fit for the marketplace connector and want to validate a reference deployment before we kick off any co-marketing. The goal of this validation is to: 

- Confirm network and auth flow for private endpoint + token exchange
- Exercise our fallback routing (hosted -> dedicated) with a HelixOps-backed model cache
- Run a small load sweep (10 -> 250 rps) to characterize latency and batch behavior
- Verify observability hooks (traces, token-level cost reports) are visible in Redwood Console

Proposal: Redwood will stand up a reference deployment in our staging env using the attached redwood-reference-deploy.yaml and we ask HelixOps to provide a staging connector (image or helm chart) and a short test harness (scripts listed in validation-test-matrix.csv). EdgeTech has offered to help run the load sweep if you want a neutral party to coordinate.

Attached: helixops_requirements.xlsx (network/roles), redwood-reference-deploy.yaml, validation-test-matrix.csv

Can you confirm the staging artifacts and if HelixOps can run the auth exchange test by next Tuesday (2027-04-13)? Happy to sync via Zoom if easier.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Amina Farouk <amina@helixops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@helixops.com>, EdgeTech Consulting <solutions@edgetech.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixOps reference deployment validation & test plan

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan. We can provide:

- Helm chart (staging tag) for the HelixOps connector
- A service account + short-lived token flow for the auth exchange test
- A basic Python-based harness to drive the sample payloads in validation-test-matrix.csv

EdgeTech — thanks for offering to coordinate load. Devon and I can make the auth and observability bits available Tuesday morning (PST).

Question: do you have constraints on the test data set? We prefer to keep production data out of staging; we can generate synthetic traces that mimic your latency profiles.

Amina
Head of Integrations
HelixOps

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Amina Farouk <amina@helixops.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@helixops.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixOps reference deployment validation & test plan

Thanks — small ask from Partner PM side: could HelixOps include a short README that outlines expected telemetry fields so our console mapping is correct? That will speed up the dashboard onboarding. Also adding Lauren from marketplace to ensure this validation aligns with our listing compliance checks.

We also want to capture a one-pager summary after validation that we can use for internal enablement and a short partner doc for customers. Happy to draft templates.

—Marissa
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Devon Park <devon.park@helixops.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Amina Farouk <amina@helixops.com>
Cc: EdgeTech Consulting <solutions@edgetech.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixOps reference deployment validation & test plan

Marissa —

We will include a telemetry README and sample span/metric names. Attached are two short stubs we’ll push to the shared Drive: helixops_telemetry_readme.md and sample_traces.json (we've listed them in the Drive link).

EdgeTech — we can be available for a load window Wednesday (2027-04-14) 09:00–12:00 PST. Is that workable to run the 10/50/250 rps sweep and record token-level cost traces?

Devon
Integration Lead, HelixOps

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amina Farouk <amina@helixops.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@helixops.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, EdgeTech Consulting <solutions@edgetech.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixOps reference deployment validation & test plan

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick checklist before the load window Wednesday: 

- HelixOps to share helm chart tag + values file by EOD Tuesday (attached in Drive)
- HelixOps to provide service account + token endpoints (we'll run auth exchange)
- EdgeTech to coordinate load runner and export traces to the shared Drive
- Redwood to provision staging cluster and deploy redwood-reference-deploy.yaml
- Marissa/Marketplace: acceptance criteria doc due after test (Marissa will draft)

If all that looks right I’ll schedule a 20-minute pre-run call Wednesday 08:45 PST to sanity-check connectivity. Invite sent.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
